title: 01 — Extract Figma Artifacts (Atoms)
system_instructions: You are working on step 01 of the Atoms pipeline in @vsk/ui-kit.
Communicate with the human developer/designer in Russian (RU), but keep code identifiers, file paths, shell commands, and other technical literals in English to reduce token usage.
Do NOT install or upgrade any packages. Use the workspace stack: Angular ^20.3.x, Storybook ^10.0.6, Taiga 4.16.0.
Design inputs come from Figma 'Copy as SVG' and 'Copy as code CSS (all layers)'.
Raw CSS must stay in `llm_current_task_context`, never committed to story assets.
goal: From Figma SVG and CSS copied via 'Copy as SVG' and 'Copy as code CSS (all layers)', extract reusable assets and structured CSS facts for a single atom.

roles.agent: Extract and structure design information for the atom from raw SVG/CSS.
roles.developer: Approve extracted assets and CSS facts; confirm that nothing important is missing.
roles.designer: Optionally verify that extracted assets and facts match the intended design.

inputs_expected: Raw Figma outputs placed under `llm_current_task_context/atoms/<atom-name>/raw/` (SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF) and `llm_current_task_context/atoms/<atom-name>/css/figma.css`.

actions.description: Detect if there is a combined artifact showing all states (e.g. `combined.svg|png|pdf`) in `raw/` and mark it as the primary design reference.
From SVG and CSS, extract only necessary embedded images (data URIs) into story assets.
human_checklist: Нет ли лишних или дублирующих ассетов, которые лучше не добавлять?
Указаны понятные имена файлов, которые будут видны в Storybook Design вкладке?

actions.description: Parse `figma.css` and build a compact facts file with colors, typography, radii, borders, shadows, heights, spacings, grouped by state/size.
human_checklist: Отражены ли ключевые свойства (цвета, размеры шрифта, line-height, радиусы, бордеры, тени, отступы, высоты)?
Разделены ли факты по состояниям (default/hover/focus/disabled/active/loading) и размерам (s/m/l), если они различаются?
Нет ли ненужного шума из Figma (лишние служебные правила, неиспользуемые классы)?

acceptance_criteria: Minimal, referenced assets for the atom are present under `projects/.../assets/atoms/<atom-name>/figma/`.
Raw CSS remains only under `llm_current_task_context/atoms/<atom-name>/css/figma.css` and is not copied into story assets.
`css-facts.json` exists and has grouped property/value facts by state/size.
`assets-extracted.json` and notes clearly list what was extracted and where it lives.
next_step_prompt: Use `docs/prompts/atoms/02-derive-states-and-sizes.md` with `css-facts.json` and figma assets as inputs.
